# Privacy & Disclaimer

## Privacy & Cookies

We use Google Analytics 4 (GA4) to collect anonymous site usage data.  
This may involve cookies to track sessions, page views, and returning visitors.

- **Cookies used:** `_ga`, `_gid`
- **Purpose:** Analyse site traffic and improve user experience  
- **IP anonymization:** Enabled  
- **Third-party access:** Data is processed by Google under their privacy policy: [https://policies.google.com/privacy](https://policies.google.com/privacy)

You may withdraw consent at any time by clearing your cookies.

## Comments

Some pages allow you to leave a comment. Comments are handled by
[Cusdis](https://cusdis.com/), which does not use cookies and does not track
you.

- **What is stored:** the nickname you type, the comment itself, the page it
  was left on, and an email address only if you choose to give one
- **Why:** so I can reply to you, and so the comment can be shown on the page
- **Moderation:** comments are not published until I have read them, and I may
  decline to publish anything off-topic, abusive or promotional
- **Third-party access:** comment data is stored by Cusdis under their privacy
  policy: [https://cusdis.com/privacy-policy](https://cusdis.com/privacy-policy)

You do not need an account to comment, and you do not have to give an email
address. If you would like a comment of yours removed, please
[contact me](contact.html) and I will delete it.
